discrepancies.description: The identity G(t(-1,16)) = -t holds only for t >= 0, as failure.tex:200 states ("Hence G(tw)=-t for t>=0"). Without the range it is false: at t = -1, G(1,-16) >= c_o - 16 d_o > 16 > 1 = -t (Lean counterexample). Only t >= 0 is needed for "unbounded below".
